title: Using Point-of-Care Video Prescriptions to Improve Aftercare Following Discharge From a Pediatric Emergency Department
brief_summary: The goal of this project is to develop the content and delivery platform that electronically distributes mobile video discharge education for underserved populations and to demonstrate utilization, satisfaction, and improved health outcomes.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* fits one of diagnostic criteria
* not previously enrolled in past week

Exclusion Criteria:

* primary language other than english or spanish
* does not consent to receive email communication
